_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the KSP LMP egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: LunaMultiplayer
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The multiplayer server for Kerbal Space Program's LunaMultiplayer mod. Installs the chosen release, checked against GitHub's checksum; the universe and the settings in LMPServer/Config are kept.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# LunaMultiplayer: downloads the chosen release of the LunaMultiplayer
# server from its GitHub releases and checks it against GitHub's SHA-256.
# The universe (saves) and the settings in LMPServer/Config are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=LunaMultiplayer/LunaMultiplayer
asset=LunaMultiplayer-Server-Release.zip
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${LMP_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "LunaMultiplayer has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo 0.29.2)."
sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }')
[ -n "$sum" ] || fail "LunaMultiplayer's release $tag has no server download."

# The settings the server's Startup page owns, before the first start;
# LunaMultiplayer fills in the rest of each file.
mkdir -p LMPServer/Config
cfg=LMPServer/Config
if [ ! -f $cfg/ConnectionSettings.xml ]; then
    cat > $cfg/ConnectionSettings.xml <<XML
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?>
<ConnectionSettingsDefinition xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <ListenAddress>::</ListenAddress>
  <Port>${SERVER_PORT:-8800}</Port>
  <Upnp>false</Upnp>
</ConnectionSettingsDefinition>
XML
fi
if [ ! -f $cfg/GeneralSettings.xml ]; then
    cat > $cfg/GeneralSettings.xml <<'XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?>
<GeneralSettingsDefinition xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <ServerName>Luna Server</ServerName>
  <Password></Password>
  <AdminPassword></AdminPassword>
  <MaxPlayers>20</MaxPlayers>
  <GameDifficulty>Normal</GameDifficulty>
  <GameMode>Sandbox</GameMode>
</GeneralSettingsDefinition>
XML
fi
echo "Installed LunaMultiplayer $tag."

if [ "$(cat .raptor-lmp 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $sum" ] && [ -f LMPServer/Server.dll ]; then
    echo "LunaMultiplayer $tag is already installed."
    exit 0
fi
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading LunaMultiplayer $tag"
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.zip" || fail "The download of LunaMultiplayer failed. Reinstall to try again."
unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/x"
[ -f "$build/x/LMPServer/Server.dll" ] || fail "LunaMultiplayer's download has no server in it."
mkdir -p LMPServer
cp -a "$build/x/LMPServer/." LMPServer/
echo "$tag $sum" > .raptor-lmp

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The LunaMultiplayer release to install, such as 0.29.2, or latest. Players need the same version of the mod.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for running admin commands from the game. Empty turns them off.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: The game's difficulty: Easy, Normal, Moderate, Hard or Custom.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: The game mode: Sandbox, Career or Science. Change it only before the universe is made.
